name: Live Subtitle Style
description: Adds a subtitle style button to the Jellyfin web player OSD. Size, font, color, background, outline and position change live, with no playback restart. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Live subtitle styling in the web player

versions.changelog: Added Google Fonts with Thai support (Sarabun, Mitr, Prompt, Kanit, Noto Sans Thai), listed as web fonts in the font field. A font is fetched from Google Fonts only when you select it, so it works on devices without the Windows Thai fonts.

The font control is a type-in field with suggestions, so any font installed on the viewing device works. Thai fonts (Angsana New, AngsanaUPC, DilleniaUPC, Cordia New, Browallia New, TH Sarabun New, Leelawadee UI) come first.
Full version history in the plugin metadata.
Font selector (live); new 'Aa' icon instead of the subtitle-picker look-alike.

Fixed the OSD and keyboard controls disappearing. File Transformation matched index.html as a regex, which also matched the video player's JavaScript chunk, and the script tag was appended to it. Only markup is modified now.
